text: Contact! Molt on the wire. Pick your targets.
I'm hit. Plate's holding. Keep firing!
Take the limbs! A bug with no scythes is just meat.
Shifting. Close that gap!
Wave's broken. Reload, and check your seals.
That's the Augur. Feelers first, then the skull!
Lifter's inbound. East gate. Move, move!
Movement at the burrows. Here they come.
Seal's cracked! Still in it.
Scythe's off. It's crawling!
Shifting. Cover me!
Contact, contact! Eyes on the dust.
Suit breach! I can still shoot.
Leg's gone. Put it down!
On the move!
Let them come close. I'll light them up.
They got through the plate! Burning them anyway.
Burn it all!
Going. Fuel's hot.
Sensors are full of them. All sides.
Pressure's dropping in my suit!
Wing's off. Skirr is down!
Understood. Relocating.
Seismic contact. More Molt rising.
Outpost Kessel, lifter is on approach. Clear the pad.
Lifter is down. Board now!
Service Bulletin Seven. The Molt come out of the ground. Wardens send them back, in pieces.
